domain.name: Emergent Multi-Agent / Speculative
domain.description: Categories that don't fully exist yet — societies of cooperating or competing agents, agent-run micro-businesses, self-modifying software written by the thing it runs.
examples: agent-run marketplace stall that negotiates its own prices
swarm of agents co-authoring a living document
AI guild that hires other AIs for sub-tasks

governance.name: Budgeted Delegation
governance.description: The agent has a spend/action budget and acts freely inside it, escalating only when it would exceed the cap.
examples: daily grocery auto-reorder under a $50 cap
ad-spend autopilot with a monthly ceiling

latency.name: Interactive (sub-second)
latency.description: Conversational, turn-based UI latency — the user waits for one reply, not a stream of frames.

pitch: A emergent multi-agent / speculative governed by budgeted delegation, operating at interactive (sub-second) latency.
